notes: PS2 HLE emulator (no BIOS). Requests a GLES 3.2 context with depth buffer, bottom-left origin, cache_context=false, XRGB8888. Writes config/memcards to <save dir>/Play Data Files (patched; upstream uses $EXTERNAL_STORAGE). Compatibility far below PCSX2/AetherSX2; expect many titles to fail or run slowly.
